notes: Confirmed the conservative selector-and-bucket label. The body gates on enabled byte object+0x428 and pointer argument+8, asks f_700183eafc for nested selector 0x13, then converts its float to signed integer. Values above 899 return 300; values at least 15 take the integer bucket calculation; values 3–14 return 1 and lower values return -2. This corrects the producer note’s lower bound from 16 to 15; the proposed name remains accurate. Caller f_7000f7b34c invokes it at the cited site.

Confirmed. The body requires nonnull input and enabled byte object+0x428, checks the nested provider result, requests selector 0x1b, converts the float to signed integer, returns -2 on failed lookup or negative values, returns 0–2 unchanged, and returns 3 for larger values. Caller f_7001014de4 passes the object and provider and stores the scalar result after this call.

Confirmed as a conservative wrapper description. It saves the original x0, sets x1 to null, calls the already named populate_and_process_attribute_record_candidate_output helper at f_700073c078, restores the original x0, then tail-calls f_700073c220. The caller f_7000437690 invokes this wrapper at line 41019; the producer’s caller source file citation was off, and the callsite is in main_0032.c.

Confirmed. The body loads a 64-bit pointer from input+0xa0, returns immediately if null, and otherwise tail-calls the accepted check_attribute_context_status_conditions helper at f_7000f01228. Caller f_7001096270 passes a pointer loaded from a global manager field and tests the returned low bit.

Independently checked the sampled blank. The body calls load_rtts_amateur_schedules with the input code, branches on codes 1 and 2, and invokes several unresolved helpers while clearing/releasing a local resource. Caller f_700046c894 invokes it in a handler path for record category 0x2f. These facts suggest a schedule related handler, but the specific operation and meaning of the branch codes are not established enough to assign a semantic name. Keep unnamed.
